tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background — the desk the sheets sit on. Warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-sheet
tokens.usage: The sheet itself (Paper component): task lists, the day schedule. One step lighter than paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed rows, the schedule's time gutter, quiet wells.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Ruled lines under task rows and hour lines in the schedule. Decorative only — never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: rule-margin
tokens.usage: The single faint red margin line on a ruled sheet. Decorative, one per sheet.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders: checkbox outline, input underline, quiet button outline. 3:1+ on paper, paper-sheet and paper-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the checkmark, on every paper and note ground (10:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hour labels, meta, event times. 4.5:1+ on every paper and note ground.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Completed (struck-through) tasks and placeholders, on paper and paper-sheet only. Intentionally quiet: 3.8:1 in Daylight, below 4.5:1 — never use it for anything the person must read to act.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: The one warm accent: primary button fill, today marker. Use sparingly — at most one ochre fill per view.

tokens.name: on-ochre
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ochre fill (6:1+).

tokens.name: ochre-ink
tokens.usage: Ochre as text or line: the day's date, active links. On paper, paper-sheet, paper-sunk and the notes.

tokens.name: note-yellow
tokens.usage: Sticky-note tint for schedule events (default). Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: note-peach
tokens.usage: Sticky-note tint for a second kind of event (e.g. personal). Text: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: note-sage
tokens.usage: Sticky-note tint for a third kind of event (e.g. health). Text: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: The 'now' line in the schedule and the focus ring. 4.9:1+ on every ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Alias of pencil.

styles.name: hand-display
styles.usage: The day heading. Once per screen.

styles.name: hand-task
styles.usage: Task text, input text, button labels.

styles.name: sans-body
styles.sample: Nothing planned yet — enjoy the quiet.
styles.usage: Longer helper text, empty states, settings.

styles.name: sans-time
styles.usage: Hour labels and event times. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Checkbox to task text; event padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a sheet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; left of the margin line.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sheets / major sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top and side breathing room on desktop.

tokens.name: rule-pitch
tokens.usage: Height of one ruled line = one task row.

tokens.name: hour-height
tokens.usage: Height of one hour in the schedule.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Sheets, inputs, schedule events — paper has square corners.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons and checkboxes: just enough to soften a pen stroke.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Maximum. Tooltips and small popovers only.

shadow.note: Paper stacks, it doesn't float. Shadows are short and warm.

tokens.name: shadow-stack
tokens.usage: A sheet with more sheets under it (the task pad).

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A single loose sheet or a popover.
